milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the hanging lantern (at spawn-relative [6, 3, 7]) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to have clearly identified the lantern (verified via sandbox: ~3.3 blocks from shelter entrance), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking in its direction (accommodates the upward angle needed to face the hanging lantern from ground level).
